subject: general
question: In June 2022, the "Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs" has approved deregulation of _____.

options.text: Sale of Domestically Produced Crude Oil

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sale of domestically produced crude oil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deregulation means that the government is removing or reducing regulations on a particular industry or market.**
 
• **In this case, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved the deregulation of the sale of domestically produced crude oil.**
 
• This means that there will be fewer restrictions on who can sell crude oil and at what price, which could potentially lead to more competition and lower prices for consumers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The sale of defence equipment and nuclear weapons are highly regulated and controlled by the government.**
 
• It would be unlikely for the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs to approve deregulation of these industries, as they are considered to be a matter of national security.
 
• The sale of chemical weapons is prohibited by international law, so it would be illegal for the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs to approve deregulation of this industry.
